Theorem
[Boundary weak Harnack inequality] 1. ch8:8.26\group ch08-generalized-solutions Under the hypotheses of Theorem 8.18, let $u$ be a supersolution nonnegative in $\Omega \cap B_{4R}(y)$. Put \[ m=\inf _{\partial \Omega \cap B_{4R}(y)}u, \qquad u_m^-(x)= egin{cases} \min \{ u(x),m\} ,& x\in \Omega ,\ m,& x otin \Omega . \end{cases} \] For $1\leq p<n/(n-2)$, egin{equation} R^{-n/p}\| u_m^-\| _{L^p(B_{2R}(y))} \leq C\left(\inf _{B_R(y)}u_m^-+k(R) ight), ag {8.70} \end{equation} where $C=C(n,\Lambda /\lambda , u R,q,p)$.
Proof

\sketch Use negative-power tests for $u_m^-+k$, subtracting the constant boundary value so the tests vanish in the Sobolev sense. Together with the positive boundary truncation, the shared test is

egin{equation} ag {8.71} v=\eta ^2 egin{cases} ar u^ eta -(M+k)^ eta ,& eta >0,\ ar u^ eta -(m+k)^ eta ,& eta <0. \end{cases} \end{equation}

The proof of Theorem 8.18 then applies unchanged.
